text: Larger Maya party returns to survey the island an establish the outpost settlement of San Lorenzo

Observatory built

Maya settlements abandoned
After centuries as a temple village with a gradually decling population, the last traces of inhabitation disappear

Land cleared for a ballcourt outside of the new village
Ekab population abandons the island and returns to Zamá
The expidition of Juan de Grijalva briefly lands on the island but leaves no permanent settlement
First Spanish landing by the Juan de Grijalva expedition, no permanent settlement

Centro settled

First meeting of the Postmaster's Conspiracy

Familia Avellaneda

Tunnel network begins operation
Leon Kasparov refuses to threaten aspiring political machine Giovani Orozco Martínez, causing a bitter rift between Kasparov and Freeman
Due to the end of prohibition, the Cardinellis begin to extort more money from SDF to make up for lost profits
